info.title: Attendance Gateway API
info.description:
Zero-Trust Cryptographic Attendance Gateway.

**Authentication**
- Most client endpoints accept a shared client API key: header `X-Api-Key: ag_...` (mint from the Admin console → API Keys).
- Role-protected endpoints (professor/admin) use a JWT: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `/api/v1/admin/login` or `/api/v1/auth/login`.
- Global security: `ApiKey OR bearer`; public operations (health, admin login) override with `[]`.

**Building a client?** See the **Client Integration Guide** (QR / 3-second metronome protocol, biometric Gate 2 ordering, timestamp sealing, 250ms window): https://git.atmyhome.tech/het/attendance-gateway/src/branch/main/docs/CLIENT_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md

**Error payloads:** every 4xx/5xx returns the envelope `{success:false,error:{code,message,latency_ms?,details?}}`. Full code table + client UI actions: **Error Dictionary** — https://git.atmyhome.tech/het/attendance-gateway/src/branch/main/docs/ERROR_DICTIONARY.md (schema: `ErrorEnvelope`).

**To get an API key:** sign in to the Admin console (https://admin.atmyhome.tech) → **API Keys** → Generate Key.
